Benchmark Volcano Plot (Highcharter)

Source: R/Benchmarking_Single.R
benchmark_volcano_hc.Rd

Volcano plot colored by Species with plotLines at expected logFC values, dispersion stats in subtitle.

Usage

benchmark_volcano_hc(
  de_res_comp,
  ev_comp,
  disp_comp = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05,
  lfc_thr = 0,
  p_col = "adj.P.Val",
  species_colors = NULL,
  point_size = 3,
  title = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

de_res_comp

DE results for one comparison

ev_comp

Expected values for one comparison

disp_comp

Dispersion metrics for one comparison (optional)

alpha

Significance threshold

lfc_thr

Log fold-change threshold

p_col

P-value column

species_colors

Named vector of colors per species

point_size

Marker radius (default: 3)

title

Custom title (optional)

height

Chart height in pixels (optional)

Value

Highchart object

Examples

data(nadia_dia)
de <- process_proteomics(nadia_dia, verbose = FALSE)$DEPs_results
sp <- utils::read.delim(system.file("extdata", "nadia_dia_spikein.tsv.gz",
                                    package = "NADIA"))
de$Species <- sp$PG.OrganismId[match(de$Protein.IDs, sp$PG.ProteinGroups)]
ev <- data.frame(Comparison = rep(c("B-A", "D-A"), each = 2),
                 Species = c("ECOLI", "YEAST"),
                 expected_logFC = c(1, -0.58, 2, -3.3))
disp <- compute_dispersion_metrics(de, ev)
benchmark_volcano_hc(de[de$Comparison == "B-A", ],
                     ev[ev$Comparison == "B-A", ],
                     disp_comp = disp[disp$Comparison == "B-A", ])
